# gtme secret

Store a credential in ~/.gtme/secrets (VALUE omitted = prompt, no echo)

## Forms

```
gtme secret set KEY [VALUE]
```

It exits with one of the [exit codes](/reference/cli#exit-codes) every verb shares.

## Example

From [Your CSV](/start/my-csv):

```sh
gtme secret set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
```

## Used in

- [Agent-operable by design](/concepts/agent-operable): The prompt where you, never the agent, enter a key after exit code 3
